title: Loves MBz
description: Exposes the MusicBrainz IDs MediaMonkey keeps in its database but never shows: Albums.MBGID (release), Albums.MBRGGID (release group) and Artists.MBGID (artist). Adds three read-only tracklist columns, a dialog that lists, copies and can set those IDs, and a Track Properties tab that links and edits per-track MusicBrainz extended tags, including adding missing tags, suggesting the IDs the library already holds, group editing of tags shared by the selected tracks, including copying a tag to the selected tracks that lack it, and a warning when a release, release-group or artist extended tag disagrees with the ID MediaMonkey keeps on the album or artist row, which can be aligned in either direction.
author: NiZDesign
